designs.name: Неон авирагч
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original playable character design concept for an existing Unity 2D side-scrolling climbing-and-shooting game with seven-floor tapered arenas: neon flood city, molten factory, ruined tower, Egyptian desert pyramid.
Create exactly ONE original adult adventurer character, one full body figure only, isolated on a truly transparent background. No scene, no floor, no typography, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no inset panels, no duplicates.
Art direction: polished crisp hand-pixelled 32-bit pixel art matching detailed pixel-art platform beams, ladders, crates and neon/Egyptian environment art. Intentional visible square pixel clusters, selective dark outline, restrained 4–5 tone shading per material, punchy readable silhouette. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not smooth vector cartoon. The anatomy is stylized compact approximately 3.5 heads tall, clearly adult, large readable helmet/head and sturdy hands/boots, made to remain distinct at small gameplay size. Character should feel like a charming serious action-game hero.
Composition: portrait canvas, centered full body occupying about 78 percent of canvas height, generous clear padding around all extremities and weapon. Orthographic shallow three-quarter SIDE view facing RIGHT, almost a side-scroller sprite, both feet visible and planted on same baseline. Comfortable grounded combat-idle stance, knees slightly bent, hands holding equipment at waist height. Avoid dramatic perspective, running poses or tiny clutter. Top-left soft highlights, consistent game lighting. Genuine alpha transparency, not a checkerboard painted into the image.
This is a concept image; do not draw an animation sheet.
Character identity and costume: NEON RUNNER: lean agile rooftop climber. White angular compact helmet with a broad dark navy glass visor and thin cyan highlight, no facial features. Cyan cropped tactical jacket with white shoulder patches, midnight-blue pants, big white-and-cyan climbing boots. Short cyan neck scarf pointing back, small rectangular navy climbing pack, two clean harness straps and a compact carabiner. Holds a compact silver and navy sci-fi pistol pointing right, trigger discipline. Balanced light agile silhouette, white helmet, cyan chest, clearly separated arms and legs. Palette white, cyan, midnight blue with one tiny warm amber indicator.
